Instruction: the edited sofa still presents the same side view; it lacks the reference's frontal row of three back cushions and right-hand projecting chaise. Quality: the furniture structure and fabric rendering are coherent without obvious artifacts.

Quality: the repair is structurally readable, with a small texture-blending issue along its lower edge; the rest of the room is coherent.
